general_information.Description: Objective: 'This project-based course equips students with language and soft skills including team-work and problem solving skills to be able to use English quite independently in common daily interactions and some limited academic situations Teaching method: lecture + acitivities + project works
general_information.StudentTasks: <- Students must attend more than 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible for doing all exercises, assignments, and labs given by the instructor in class or at home and submitting them on time - Use a laptop in class only for learning purposes - Access the course website for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online support from teachers and other students, and for practicing and assessment.
general_information.Tools: 1. textbook + app for extra practice 2. An English community room with glass walls: 2.1. Functions: self-study, tutorial, group work (group discussion), club activities, project performance, English events 2.2. Design: + 1 reception desk + 2 hexagonal table sets + 2 small round table sets + 3 rectangular table sets for group work + 1 set of long table and high chairs along the glass wall for self study + 1 stage with a podium for project performance and events + Shelves with a provision of popular books and board game sets + 1 air hockey table for recreation + Wall grid panels for displaying students' works + English quotations on the wall 2.3. Devices: a projector + a screen, a computer, a sound system + microphones, flipcharts, a fixed video conference camera for livestreaming
general_information.Note: 1) On-going assessment - Progress tests: 02*15%: 30% - Presentations: 02*10%: 20% - Project: 01*20%: 20% 2) Final Examination (FE) 30% 3) Final Result 100% 4) Completion Criteria: On-going assessment >0, each part of the final exam must be >0, Final Exam Score >=4/10 & Final Result >=5/10

description: Objective: 'This project-based course equips students with language and soft skills including team-work and problem solving skills to be able to use English quite independently in common daily interactions and some limited academic situations Teaching method: lecture + acitivities + project works

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Get the key message and some important details of speakers’ utterances in popular accents that contain some unfamiliar vocabulary without much difficulty.

Demonstrate understanding of the essential points and ability to respond when engaged in controlled conversations on topics such as narration of factual materials, description, or topics that involve familiar fields of knowledge with some lack of fluency.
Initiate, maintain and end face-to-face or telephone conversations on familiar topics containing some complex grammatical structures such as perfect tenses, passive voice, or some adverbial clauses
Identify main idea and key points to unfamiliar reading passages at the intermediate level
Demonstrate some basic critical thinking over others' opinions in written documents or speeches
Write simple, compound and some complex sentences with minor errors that do not affect understanding
Write a letter in the education domain and a narrative paragraph of approximately 100 words within 45 minutes
Actively and effectively apply group work and problem-solving skills in fulfilling projects
